title: Novel 3-(pyrazol-4-yl)-2-(1H-indole-3-carbonyl)acrylonitrile derivatives induce intrinsic and extrinsic apoptotic death mediated P53 in HCT116 colon carcinoma.
authors: Mohamed, Magda F; Ibrahim, Nada S; Saddiq, Amna A; Abdelhamid, Ismail A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型吲哚查尔酮衍生物的抗结肠癌活性及凋亡机制，分子对接仅针对小分子与癌症相关蛋白，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A novel series of alpha-cyano indolylchalcones was prepared, and their chemical structures were confirmed based on the different spectral data. Among them, compound 7f was observed to be the most effective bioactive chalcone with distinguished potency and selectivity against colorectal carcinoma (HCT(116)) with IC(50) value (6.76 microg/mL) relative to the positive control (5 FU) (77.15 microg/mL). In a preliminary action study, the acrylonitrile chalcone 7f was found to enhance apoptotic action via different mechanisms like inhibition of some anti-apoptotic protein expression, regulation of some apoptotic proteins, production of caspases, and cell cycle arrest. All mechanisms suggested that compound 7f could act as a professional chemotherapeutic agent. Also, a molecular docking study was achieved on some selected proteins implicated in cancer (Caspase 9, XIAP, P53 mutant Y220C, and MDM2) which showed variable interactions with compound 7f with good Gibbs free energy scores.
abstract_zh: 制备了一系列新型α-氰基吲哚基查尔酮，并通过不同的光谱数据确认了其化学结构。其中，化合物7f被观察到是最有效的生物活性查尔酮，对结直肠癌（HCT(116)）具有显著的功效和选择性，其IC(50)值（6.76微克/毫升）相对于阳性对照（5 FU）（77.15微克/毫升）更为优越。在初步作用研究中，丙烯腈查尔酮7f被发现通过多种机制增强凋亡作用，如抑制某些抗凋亡蛋白表达、调节某些凋亡蛋白、产生半胱天冬酶以及细胞周期阻滞。所有机制均表明，化合物7f可作为专业的化疗药物。此外，对涉及癌症的选定蛋白质（Caspase 9、XIAP、P53突变体Y220C和MDM2）进行了分子对接研究，结果显示其与化合物7f存在多种相互作用，并具有较好的吉布斯自由能评分。
